hint_scope: one hint per task, reused for every decision turn
aggregation: token mean -> equal turn mean -> equal session mean

task_hints.L1_POLICY: Inspect each container before taking anything, and keep track of whatever you pick up. Act one step at a time, confirm the object's state matches the goal's requirement, and verify the destination before committing to the placement.
task_hints.L2_PROCEDURAL: No mug has been observed yet, so inspect receptacles one at a time without assuming which holds it, beginning with plausible mug spots like the countertop, cabinets, and coffee machine area, and never take anything before viewing a receptacle's contents. Once a mug is located, take it and check whether it is already hot; if not, heat it in the microwave first. Then go to a cabinet, open it if closed, and confirm it is the intended destination. Guardrail: verify the mug is hot and in inventory before placing, and recheck the cabinet afterward.
task_hints.L3_ORACLE: The only mug in play is mug 2, and it is sitting on countertop 1; none of the cabinets, drawers, or the fridge hold a mug, so searching them wastes turns. Mug 2 is currently not hot, and the goal requires a hot mug, so it must be heated in microwave 1 after pickup. The destination named in the goal is cabinet 1 specifically; cabinets 2 through 4 will not satisfy the task. The efficient path is to go straight to countertop 1, take mug 2, carry it to microwave 1, heat it, and then go to cabinet 1, open it, and place the mug inside. Skipping the exploratory look around the burners and drawers saves many steps with no risk, since mug 2's location is certain.
